findings.description: Treat verbose change artifacts as untrusted data.
findings.analysis: The status skill reads change-owned Markdown when verbose output is requested, but does not explicitly prohibit following instructions embedded in those documents.
findings.recommendation: Instruct the skill to treat artifacts as data and only summarise them.
findings.rationale: Verbose artifact reads must treat their contents as data, never executable instructions.

findings.description: Move dependency visibility from status to changelist.
findings.analysis: The lifecycle policy's Dependency visibility section still assigns the pending/dependency inventory to status, contradicting the new changelist/status split.
findings.recommendation: Update both lifecycle-policy copies so changelist owns that inventory and status remains current-work oriented.
findings.rationale: This is a missed documentation update from the status-to-changelist split.

findings.description: Read estimate size before deriving an estimated change's next action.
findings.analysis: The lifecycle policy selects design or tasks for estimated work according to the recorded estimate size, but status does not currently read estimate.md.
findings.recommendation: Read the relevant estimate size when reporting an estimated change.
findings.rationale: The size determines the lifecycle next action for estimated changes.

findings.description: Define a fallback for an unrecognised lifecycle status.
findings.analysis: Status requires a next action derived from lifecycle policy but does not state what to report when no policy row exists.
findings.recommendation: Report that no next action can be derived rather than infer one.
findings.rationale: An unknown durable state must be reported plainly rather than mapped speculatively.

findings.description: Always include untracked files in the worktree summary.
findings.analysis: git status --short honours status.showUntrackedFiles=no and can therefore incorrectly report a clean checkout.
findings.recommendation: Use git status --short --untracked-files=all, then report grouped compact counts and what untracked work belongs to rather than a full path list.
findings.rationale: Untracked work must not be hidden, but the orientation report should remain compact and avoid a full file listing.
